crossRefs.note: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives…
Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply…
He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them as his…
Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen…
The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and…
Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand…
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself; with a cedar…

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

translations.web: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Absalom provided for himself a chariot with horses and fifty men to run ahead of him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him a chariot and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
